title: Campus-Level Amounts in the 2026-27 UIL Academic and Robotics Fee Schedule (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
Under **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees**, the 2026-27 UIL Academic and Robotics fee schedule adds a level amount to the participation fee of a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03. The level amount turns on two facts together: the campus of the participation (the campus whose program the student joins) and the grade on the student's district enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year, as kept by Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions.

**Clause.** A level amount is added: minus 15.00 for a participation at an elementary campus whose student's enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year shows grade 02 through 05, minus 10.00 for a participation at a middle school campus whose student's enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year shows grade 06 through 08, and nothing otherwise.

The elementary campuses are Alder Springs Elementary, Bluebonnet Trail Elementary, Cypress Hollow Elementary, Live Oak Elementary and Pecan Grove Elementary; the middle school campuses are Hollis Middle School and Ridgecrest Middle School.

## Combinations

| Campus of the participation | Grade on the enrollment record | Level amount |
|---|---|---|
| an elementary campus | 02 through 05 | minus 15.00 |
| an elementary campus | any other grade | nothing |
| a middle school campus | 06 through 08 | minus 10.00 |
| a middle school campus | any other grade | nothing |
| any other campus | any grade | nothing |
| any campus | no enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year | nothing |

A level amount is a negative amount: minus 15.00 lowers the amounts of the schedule by 15.00, minus 10.00 by 10.00.
